Sandbox_CCS_MaxClaimsPerPlayer_tooltip: How many vehicles one account can have claimed at once. 0 is no limit.
Sandbox_CCS_InactivityDays_tooltip: A claim lapses when its owner has not logged in for this many real days. 0 means claims never lapse.
Sandbox_CCS_IdleShutoffMinutes_tooltip: Any vehicle left running with nobody in the driver's seat is switched off after this many real minutes, claimed or not. Checked once a minute. 0 turns this off.
